WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_telescopes AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM telescopes
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / tt.total_count as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt
),
average_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_share
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.observstation,
    ws.telescope_count,
    ws.share,
    ws.share - ac.avg_share as difference
  FROM with_share ws
  CROSS JOIN average_calc ac
  WHERE ws.share > ac.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  difference
FROM above_average
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
